answers.core: As a basic string operation this should really be in core.
answers.workaround:
Yes, however as a basic string operation this should really be in core.
```gdscript
func _str_erase(str: String, pos: int, len := 1) -> String:
	return str.left(max(pos, 1)) + str.substr(pos + len)
```
The alternative is writing equivalent expression everywhere it's needed.
The engine is also using this approach as seen in the changes in godotengine/godot#54869
